findings.title: Recheck effective provider selection when consuming derivative admission
findings.requirement: M10B2 exact result/descriptor and incumbent M08/M14 admission; PROP074 says native/plugin/skill effects receive no inferred grant from builtin decision.
findings.scenario: Bind grant using the fixture target provider=None and default builtin deploy:vibe-bin. Copy DeployExecution with same descriptor, roots, principal,generation and result but replace routes with deploy:vibe-bin -> an uninstalled provider or registry selecting a native provider. decide only checks target IDs/struct equality and root host preflight; it never calls resolve_mechanism again, so returns AdmittedAtFixtureStop although current provider is unsupported or outside admitted builtin lane.
source_evidence: derivative.rs:80-89 resolves and restricts only during bind
derivative.rs:94-98 retains no resolved provider or registry/route basis
vibe-extension-registry/src/mechanism/resolve.rs:270-281 target pin then host route then default; changed route can change or refuse same descriptor
findings.smallest_remedy: Use existing resolve_mechanism again at decision admission, retaining/comparing the approved provider identity as needed; refuse missing,disabled,replaced or non-builtin resolution before destination lock. Add one narrow same-target changed-route negative case. No provider launch or new engine required.
findings.evidence_strength: Deterministic source flow; not executed. Existing4 lifecycle cases mutate target descriptor/roots/grant/artifact, not routes/registry.

scope: Full literal M10B2 task, full PROP074/PROJECT-BOUNDARIES, all6 new implementation/test files, all4 registration/spec diffs, direct existing artifact+host+resolution+binder owners
perimeter: 10 files all within literal scope;BACKLOG excluded;no manifests/wire/schema changes
line_budget: New owners95/70/168 lines; tests212/144/265. Existing registration owners960/848 lines pre-exist and only gain glue.
limits: Fixture decisions only; no production activation,provider launch or external installation required/qualified
Five families get byte-inventory checks, not semantic XML/Vibe/native ABI compatibility
Package-skill uses actual lower_project_skill_bindings and incumbent receipt refusal
